headline: Roosevelt stand alone as the conference's unbeaten side
dek: Roosevelt beat Purdue Northwest at home, handing the visitors a defeat they had avoided all season and leaving every other programme with a loss to their name. Roosevelt have won six and drawn three since the season began.
displaced_by: Roosevelt beat Purdue Northwest on 2026-09-20: Purdue Northwest are no longer without a loss and Northern Michigan have since drawn, so the standing dek was untrue.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The scoring is top-heavy: Northern Michigan alone have scored more than Purdue Northwest and St. Cloud State together.

wire.line: Luca Rosen has scored nine of Northern Michigan's eighteen goals, and Roosevelt, the only unbeaten side, are yet to face him.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches whose dates have passed carry no published result, the earliest of them Northern Michigan's opening match against Green Bay.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Roosevelt's six wins are more than any other programme has managed.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Luca Rosen has scored nine goals from 33 shots for Northern Michigan.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Matty Telfer has scored seven of Saginaw Valley State's seventeen goals, from eighteen shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Cedrik Strupler has kept four shutouts in goal for Roosevelt.

last_match.line: Purdue Northwest had neither lost nor failed to score in a match this season until this one.

next_match.line: Roosevelt have yet to lose; St. Cloud State have lost both conference matches they have played, each of them at home.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
